title: ChSON Document
description: A structured format for knowledge fragments based on cognitive science principles of retrieval and chunking. Supports cheatsheets, checklists, runbooks, TLDRs, bookmarks, and more.

version.description: Version of the subject matter this document covers.

publicationDate.description: When this document was published or last updated.

description.description: A brief summary of what this document covers.

documentType.description: The type of document, which may influence rendering. 'cheatsheet': quick reference for commands/shortcuts. 'checklist': ordered tasks to complete. 'runbook': step-by-step operational procedures. 'tldr': brief summaries of topics. 'bookmarks': curated link collections.

retrievalDirection.description: The cognitive lookup direction. 'intent-to-mechanism': user knows what they want to do, needs the command/shortcut. 'mechanism-to-meaning': user sees a command/syntax, needs to understand what it does.

anchorLabel.description: Display name for the anchor column (default: 'Anchor'). Use 'Example' for code samples, 'Shortcut' for keyboard shortcuts, etc.

contentLabel.description: Display name for the content column (default: 'Content'). Use 'Description' for explanations, 'Action' for intent-based lookups, etc.

title.description: The name of this section (chunk category).

description.description: Optional explanation of what this section covers.

entries.description: The anchor-content pairs in this section.

anchor.description: The retrieval anchor: what users scan for. Typically a command, shortcut, or action name.

content.description: The associated content: what users need to know once they find the anchor.

label.description: Optional human-readable label when the anchor is cryptic (e.g., 'gg' might have label 'Go to start').

comments.description: Optional notes, warnings, or additional context.
